prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of a single black-and-white zine manifesto sheet on a scratched wooden table. The lighting is harsh overhead fluorescent, creating faint drum-line photocopy streaks. The paper is cheap A5 photocopier stock, slightly creased.

Subject:
A single-page manifesto page covered in jagged ransom-note style cut-out letters at explosively different sizes and rotations, forming block paragraphs of wordlike shapes. A torn silhouette of a raised fist is glued toward the lower-left with rubber cement halo. Scratched marker lines underline random fragments. A small sheet-corner has been torn clean off and left on the table beside.

Important details:
Every cut-out letter must be physically scissor-trimmed with ragged edges and a faint shadow. Some letters must be pasted upside down. Glue halos are yellow-brown translucent, not digital. Marker scratches must show pen pressure variance. The torn-off corner piece on the table should cast its own small shadow separate from the main sheet.

Use case:
Independent single image in the Collage Moods package, representing the punk manifesto voice.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no vector type, no clean alignment, no symmetry, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
